api-reference.title: API Reference
api-reference.description: All public types and key APIs exported by RheaKit.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.description: RheaKit follows a layered architecture: views observe shared state, shared state is populated by a single API client, and the API client handles auth and transport.

components/aletheia.title: AletheiaView
components/aletheia.description: A proof store and ontology browser. Displays immutable tribunal proofs and hypothesis verification chains from the Aletheia subsystem.

components/bio-renderer.title: BioRendererView
components/bio-renderer.description: A 3D molecular visualization component powered by 3Dmol.js running inside a WKWebView. Supports PDB lookup, SMILES input, multiple render styles, and tribunal-powered molecule analysis.

components/clipboard.title: ClipboardView
components/clipboard.description: A cross-device clipboard manager. Sync text, URLs, and code snippets between devices via the Rhea backend with support for pinning, expiry, and privacy levels.

components/dialog.title: DialogView
components/dialog.description: A tribunal-powered chat interface for conversational AI queries. Sends prompts to the Rhea multi-model consensus engine and displays responses with agreement scores, model counts, and response times.

components/governor.title: GovernorView
components/governor.description: A real-time budget and pace dashboard for monitoring AI agent resource consumption. Displays token burn charts, per-agent status cards, and operational mode indicators.

components/node-editor.title: NodeEditorView
components/node-editor.description: A visual pipeline editor for constructing multi-model verification workflows. Users drag nodes onto an infinite canvas, connect them with wires, configure each node, and execute the pipeline against the Rhea backend.

components/processes.title: ProcessesView
components/processes.description: A supervisor session manager for spawning, monitoring, and controlling agent processes. Provides real-time output viewing and interactive input for running sessions.

components/pulse-monitor.title: PulseMonitorView
components/pulse-monitor.description: A system-level monitoring dashboard showing agent pulse status, task queue health, and lease states. Designed for ops-console oversight of the multi-agent system.

components/tasks.title: TasksView
components/tasks.description: A kanban-style task management view for tracking work across the multi-agent system. Supports filtering by status, agent, and priority, with the ability to create new tasks.

components/team-chat.title: TeamChatView
components/team-chat.description: A live multi-agent radio feed and chat interface. Displays real-time messages between AI agents (Rex, Orion, Hyperion, etc.) and allows the human operator to send messages into the agent network.

design-system.title: Design System
design-system.description: RheaKit's visual language is defined in RheaTheme — a single enum with static color constants, semantic color functions, and the GlassCard view modifier.

getting-started.title: Getting Started
getting-started.description: This guide walks you through adding RheaKit to your SwiftUI app and rendering your first component.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: RheaKit is a SwiftUI component library for building AI-driven control interfaces. It provides a complete set of views for monitoring multi-agent systems, visualizing molecular structures, managing tasks, and interacting with tribunal-based consensus engines.
